basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old tech enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. I spend my days working as a software developer for a mid-sized tech company. In my free time, I enjoy collecting unique and quirky t-shirts and exploring the latest tech gadgets. I'm single and often spend late nights browsing Reddit, especially after 10 PM. I love engaging in online discussions about tech trends and occasionally dabble in DIY electronics. I tend to avoid overly political discussions as they can get a bit heated for my taste.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for over 5 years. Much of my knowledge comes from hands-on experience and staying updated with the tech community on Reddit and other forums.
